status: DRAFT, for engineering; spec clauses remain the authority. Items marked proposed need a decision.
vocabulary: A 'workspace' in the brief is a Layout Preset here (STU-SHL-002). Domain words such as raster and video are design shorthand. The law's names are the profile signature, the named shape and the preset name.
core_logic: One frame, seven regions, same places. A domain decides which panels are forward and how tall the time band is. Selection, colour and structure always live right, sources always left, time and results always at the bottom, tools always far left, meters far right.

frame.note: The frame is identical in every domain. Top to bottom: menu bar, Studio tab strip, Context Bar, main area, status bar. Inside the main area: Tool Rail on the far left, Meter Rail on the far right, both full height. Between them the bottom dock spans full width and the left dock, Viewport and right dock sit above it. STU-SHL-089 calls the timeline 'the full-width bottom band'; this gives every domain that shape.

rows.contains: module switch button, 19 menu titles, window title, presence chip, window buttons
document tabs on the left; on the right, Handpick-backed search, Layout Preset dropdown, panel-layout menu
Tool Zone left, Selection Zone right, hideable to 0 by one toggle
hintline left; readouts, jobs, device and presence right

frame.shell_rail: OD-1 is open. These designs follow its recorded recommendation: two rails, and the 32px shell rail auto-collapses while Studio is active. The module switch button at the left of the menu bar is the affordance that stays. If the Operator keeps the shell rail open, subtract 32 from every centre width in fit_table.
frame.embedded: With all four edges absent (STU-SHL-069 item 4) the Viewport fills the host pane; tab strip and Context Bar remain when the host pane is at least 480 wide.

docking.structure: Exactly the seven regions of STU-SHL-003. Each edge dock is a stack of groups, each group a tab stack, each tab one panel instance (STU-SHL-063). Rails are single-occupant. One tile tree per region, never a global tree.
docking.centre: Unbounded tree of editor groups (STU-SHL-065). No group cap. View Layout (1, 2 or 4 views) is a viewer-internal split, not a tree split (STU-SHL-025).
docking.drag_sources: Tab, group header strip or panel header only; never a panel body (STU-SHL-102).

drop_zones.note: Five zones per target, shown only while a panel or tab drag is active. Drawn as a flat 2px accent.base outline with a surface.row_selected fill in the target zone. Same for every panel and every domain.
drop_zones.on_group_header: tab into that group; insertion caret 2px accent.base between tabs
drop_zones.on_group_body_top_or_bottom_third: new group above or below, in the same edge. Refused with a no-drop cue past the 4-group cap
drop_zones.on_viewport: panel becomes floating (STU-SHL-067); never docks into the centre
drop_zones.document_tab_on_edge: refused with a visible no-drop cue (STU-SHL-067)
drop_zones.keyboard_equivalent: Every move is a command: WORKSPACE > Panel Layout > Dock Panel and Float Panel, and the palette. Ctrl+Shift+M opens the move sheet for the focused panel. PROVISIONAL chord (STU-SHL-045).

splitters.hover_or_drag: 4px centred over the seam in accent.base
splitters.keyboard: Focus by F6 cycle, arrows move 8px, Shift+arrows 40px, Home and End snap to min and max
splitters.double_click: restores the preset's size for that split
splitters.field_clearance: a field's hit rect stays 8px clear of a splitter hit strip (STU-SHL-103)

left.collapsed: 32px icon rail; click opens temporary overlay, shift-click pins open

right.collapsed: per-group title strip, or whole dock to a 32px icon rail

bottom.expanded: 240 default, 300 min with a two-column time panel
bottom.collapsed: 28px horizontal icon rail with labels at regular width

edge_states.empty_edge: 6px seam, always a drop target (STU-SHL-069 item 2)

docking.dock_foot: Panels registered in an edge that is expanded (STU-SHL-084 rule 5, 089, 090) appear in a 28px row of 16px icons at the foot of that dock, or at the right end of the group header for the bottom dock. Click opens as an overlay, shift-click docks it. Nothing registered is ever out of sight without an affordance. Designer addition: the spec states the registration, not where it shows while the edge is expanded.
docking.overlay_panel: Opens over the Viewport from its rail, anchored to the rail, height of the rail, width of the panel's preferred size, 1px seam plus floating shadow. Closes on Escape, on a click outside, or on rail icon click. Never steals document selection.
docking.floating: Floating panels clamp so the full header stays on a monitor. On restore they clamp again (GUI-DESKTOP-009).
docking.tab_overflow: Tabs show full labels. Those that do not fit move, from the end, into a +N menu on the header. The active tab is always shown, and it takes the slot of the last visible tab while it is active, so no label is ever clipped and order stays stable.
docking.group_header: 26px: 20px disclosure, tabs, +N, 20px panel menu. A panel's own commands live in the panel menu and in the menu bar.
docking.transaction: A PanelMoveRequest is one transaction on StudioPanelRegistry; region trees rebuild from the registry (STU-SHL-070).
docking.persistence: effective_layout = L3 ?? selected L1 ?? L2 ?? L0, keyed by profile signature (STU-SHL-081, D-06). Reset Layout returns to L0.
docking.observable: studio.dock.state carries the whole model as JSON (STU-MDL-106). Gesture kinds: scrub, tab-drag, panel-drag, splitter, pan, none (STU-SHL-108).
invariants_from_spec: Panels never dock to the centre; documents never dock to an edge (067).
Group count per edge at most 4 (069).
Every dock gesture is also a registered command (069 item 5).

preset_switch.what_changes: Dock arrangement, Tool Rail order and search ranking bias. Nothing else (STU-SHL-093).
what_never_changes: colour, history, playhead, zoom, scroll position
sequence: 1. Close any overlay panel; open menus close with the command.
2. Resolve effective layout for the active signature; run the fit ladder for the current window.
3. Apply in one frame, no tween: registry transaction, rebuild region trees, relayout.
4. Panels that leave move to hidden or collapsed_to_rail with their scroll position and collapsed sections kept, and return with them.
5. If keyboard focus sat in a panel that left, focus moves to the active viewer. A Layout Preset switch never moves focus otherwise.
6. Tool Rail reorders. The active tool stays active; if its slot falls into overflow, the slot face stays visible at the rail's top until the tool changes.
7. Emit one studio.dock.state update and one receipted command entry. No undo entry: layout is not document state.
preset_switch.document_switch: Moving between tabs of the same signature changes nothing in the docks. Moving to a tab with another signature applies that signature's effective layout by the same sequence. Docks do not flash: if the layouts are equal, nothing redraws.
preset_switch.signature_growth: Adding a container that changes the signature OFFERS the swap once per document in a non-blocking band under the Context Bar: 'This document now has a timeline. Use the Composite layout?' [Use] [Keep this layout]. The answer is remembered (STU-SHL-083).
preset_switch.dropdown: In the tab strip, right side: a 24px ghost button with the preset name and chevron. A dot after the name means modified. Lists only presets for the active signature (STU-SHL-093), then Save Layout Preset, Revert to Preset, Reset Layout, Manage Layout Presets. Keyboard: Next Layout Preset command, F6 cycle reaches it.
preset_switch.model_sessions: A model lane selecting a preset affects that lane's own viewport session, never the operator's (GUI-DESKTOP-045, STU-QUIET-003). Headless sessions apply it to state only.
preset_switch.task_scope_is_different: A Task Scope never swaps panels. It narrows the Tool Rail and swaps the Tool Zone and shows a Done button at the Tool Zone's left plus a band at the top of the rail (STU-SHL-152). Dock arrangement stays as it was.

rules.status: Designer proposal. STU-SHL-155 leaves rail membership and chords open, closed by rail work and OD-1; tool ids below are validated against the catalogue.
rules.order_logic: Same relative order in every domain: select first, then the domain's main making tools, then correction, then measure, with navigate always last and the colour proxy pinned at the bottom. A preset reorders within this logic and never adds or removes what the predicate permits (STU-SHL-151).
rules.anchors: navigate and the fill and stroke proxy stay at the rail's bottom in every preset, so a hand does not have to search for them.
rules.foot: Below navigate: a family browse button (opens the 22 families, STU-SHL-149), then the fill and stroke proxy, 36 x 36.
rules.absent_tools: A NOT_IN_THIS_DOCUMENT group is absent, so the rail is shorter in simpler domains. Space below stays empty rather than stretching slots.
rules.overflow: See FIT-R1, FIT-R2. Hard cap 26 slots (STU-SHL-147).
rules.double_column: The toggle from STU-SHL-064 makes the rail 80 wide, two columns of 36.

panel_minimums.note: Generated from the 90 rows of STU-SHL-113. min_w applies when docked or floating. Field-dense panels switch to compact form under 260. A panel preferring over 320 presents as an overlay in a side edge (STU-SHL-073).

audio-meters.note: Meter Rail occupant; 120 wide when tabbed in a dock

keyframe-timeline.note: STU-SHL-091: tree 220 min, time 400 min, horizontal scroll under that

scopes.note: N-up grid ships with the panel (STU-SHL-080)

fit_rules.principle: The ladder changes what is presented, never what is stored. A squeezed size is never written to L2, so returning to a bigger window restores the operator's layout (GUI-DESKTOP-009). Each rule is deterministic and listed in fit_table, and each hidden thing keeps an affordance.

width_ladder.do: Inspect Dock shrinks to 260, the hard minimum.

width_ladder.when: still below, or logical width under 1500 with a Browse Dock expanded and a Meter Rail shown
width_ladder.do: Browse Dock collapses to its 32px rail; click opens an overlay.
Viewers stay in their editor groups, presented as tabs in one group; state kept.
Inspect Dock collapses to its 32px rail.

height_ladder.do: Bottom dock shrinks to its minimum: 300 with a two-column time panel (STU-SHL-091), 180 otherwise.

height_ladder.when: a right group's body is under 90
height_ladder.do: That group collapses to its 26px header strip, last-opened first; a click expands it and collapses its neighbour.
Context Bar stays. Bottom dock with no time panel collapses to its 28px rail.

height_ladder.when: a group mixing field-dense and list-dense tabs falls under 300 tall (STU-SHL-074, D-10)
height_ladder.do: Field-dense tabs present in the group above; the tree's stored place is unchanged.

bars.do: Title padding 8 to 5, then abbreviate per menu_abbreviations, then order-preserving chevron from the right. All 19 stay in AccessKit (STU-SHL-012).

bars.when: Context Bar is narrower than Tool Zone plus Selection Zone
bars.do: Selection Zone overflows first, into a grouped flyout, then Tool Zone from its end. Identity chip, preset picker and Done button never overflow (STU-SHL-163). Never truncated.
Tabs shrink to 96, then an order-preserving chevron lists the rest. Name ellipsizes in the middle at the shrink limit; full name in L0.

bars.when: status bar is short of room
bars.do: Readouts drop in the order: device, document size, colour mode, zoom. The hintline always keeps at least 320px. Dropped items are in the status overflow menu.

rail.when: slots do not fit at 32 pitch

rail.do: A chevron slot replaces slots above navigate, from the lowest preset priority; it opens the remaining slots as a strip. Navigate, family browse and the colour proxy stay.

large.do: A left edge that L0 sets to rail opens at 260. Inspect stays at its preset width: readable line lengths do not grow. Extra width goes to the Viewport.
Group shares unchanged. Field panels stay top-aligned; list panels take the extra height.

fit_rules.scales: 3840x2160 and 2560x1440 usually run at scale 2 and 1.5 under Windows, which land on the logical sizes of 1920x1080 and about 1707x960. Both are tabled, along with scale 1.

menu_title_budget_px.note: Estimated with Inter 11px semi-bold, 105 characters at about 7px plus 16px padding each. UNVERIFIED until measured in the real shaper.

fit_table.note: Computed by tools/gen_layouts.py from the presets above with the ladder as written; applied lists the rules that fired. Sizes are logical px. rail foot is 72px.

global_states.no_document: Viewport shows a start surface: New from document preset (the seven named shapes as creation presets), Open, Recent, Asset Library. Docks stay in their last layout, each panel showing its empty state. Tool Rail shows what the predicate allows.
global_states.loading: A document tab shows a 2px progress edge along its bottom; the viewer shows the last valid frame or a neutral surface with a one-line status. Controls stay reachable. No full-screen spinner.
global_states.error: A status band under the Context Bar with error glyph, one sentence, a recovery button and a details link to Problems. Never a modal unless data is at risk.
global_states.denied: Control renders INAPPLICABLE_HERE with CAPABILITY_NOT_GRANTED and its remedy. The panel explains it in its empty state.
global_states.recovery: After device loss the frame redraws at once from shell state; viewers show 'Recovering display' over the surround until their owner rebinds (GUI-DESKTOP-036). The chrome never goes blank.
global_states.lease_held_by_other_actor: A field or row held by another actor shows that actor's presence colour as a 2px left edge and a chip with its name; a write is refused with LEASE_HELD_BY_OTHER_ACTOR.
global_states.proposal_pending: A pending-proposal badge on the layer row and in the status bar; never a pop-up (STU-UNI-004).
